universe_note: Chain-level screen (method §6): universe built per LINK across all 11 links, worked in priority order — money corner (global-hydro-spillover) first, then the CHOKE_POINT (yajiang-developer), then by impact. Every row carries the link_id that surfaced it and a money_corner flag. TWO LINKS CONTRIBUTE NO ROWS AND THAT IS A FINDING, NOT AN OMISSION: yajiang-developer is the choke point with impact 95 and is UNINVESTABLE (a state-owned project vehicle with no listed line), and power-offtake is policy-assured demand with no separable listed expression. The chain's single most impactful link is therefore un-buyable, which is the central fact this screen surfaces. NO EDGAR FULL-TEXT SEARCH WAS RUN: 16 of 20 names are Chinese A/H, Indian or Austrian listings with no SEC filings, so supplier-side EDGAR discovery is structurally blind here, exactly as the chain's map_limitation states. The universe is therefore chain-research only, and no name was added by disclosure. NO EARNINGS NUGGETS ARE RECORDED: data/edgar/docs/ holds no document for any name here, and the verbatim rule fails closed rather than quoting unverifiable text. Every theme_revenue_exposure is null with basis, never estimated. GEV is the only name with market data on disk; the other 19 are PENDING_DATA with request rows queued this run.
